bayts.text: The multitude of creation has humbled itself before the might of a Lord Who sent down the sūras; and He is the One Who makes forms beautiful.
I have turned my face to Him, His slave forever, possessed of service to the Messenger of Allah, like the great ones.
I offer him with gifts supererogatory praise, and with blessing, with a love that bequeaths greatness.
He has upon me, for the Countenance of Allah, not for vanity, debts of praise that increase precedence and the ways (to good).
Turn the hearts of the enemies, O Lord, in my lifetime, to my support, and tame for me all the emirs.
Bless him and grant peace, with the noble, and grant me through him safety in the two Abodes and glad tidings.
I have called upon You today: subject the enemies to me forever, tame the Accursed for me and tame the jinn and men for me.
I left in Rajab what You know: so spare me it, and grant me the verses and the sūras.
Grant me to sit (in devotion) with the deeds that please You: You have made life abide for me, O You Who made forms beautiful.
